title: Infrastructure
description: Servers, clusters, databases and domains your organization runs, with live health from the OpsHub agent.

assets.emptyManage: Add a server, cluster, database or domain to start tracking it.
assets.formIntro: Assets are shared by everyone in the organization. Tags help you group and filter them.

form.name: Name

addressHint.server: Host name or IP address, e.g. web-1.internal or 10.0.0.12.
addressHint.domain: Domain name to watch, e.g. example.com. OpsHub checks its TLS certificate.

form.tagsHint: Separated by commas or spaces, e.g. prod, web, region:sg.
form.metadataHint: One KEY=value per line, e.g. provider=hetzner.

assets.deleteBody: Its metrics, certificate history and agent token are deleted too. A running agent stops being accepted.

agent.title: Agent
agent.rotateBody: The current token stops working immediately. Update the agent with the new token to keep receiving metrics.
agent.none: No agent has been set up for this server.
agent.noneManage: Create an agent token, then run the OpsHub agent on this server to report CPU, memory and disk usage.
agent.tokenBody: Copy the token now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, rotate it.
agent.linuxOnly: The agent reports metrics on Linux only. It runs as a non-root user and only reads /proc and disk usage.

metrics.title: Usage
metrics.noData: No data in this time range.
metrics.noAgent: Metrics appear once the agent is running.
metrics.sourceHourly: Each point covers {{step}}, from hourly rollups.

certificates.description: TLS certificates of your domains. OpsHub checks each one daily, and hourly after a failure.
certificates.notChecked: This certificate has not been checked yet.
certificates.emptyHint: Add a domain asset to watch its certificate.
certificates.subject: Subject
